+path=src/slatepress/cli.py
+import argparse
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='slatepress')
+    parser.add_argument('source', help='Source directory containing Markdown files')
+    parser.add_argument(
+        '-o', '--output',
+        default='_site',
+        help='Output directory for generated site (default: _site)'
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    source_path = Path(args.source)
+    if not source_path.is_dir():
+        return 2
+
+    try:
+        from .builder import build_site
+    except ImportError:
+        # Fallback for when module is run as script
+        from slatepress.builder import build_site
+
+    build_site(source_path, Path(args.output))
+    return 0
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
+
